items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>For many years, certain “paradoxes,” usually called the reversibility paradox and the recurrence paradox, have plagued the development of nonequilibrium statistical mechanics. For some time, they led to the belief that there is a fundamental contradiction between Hamiltonian dynamics and the irreversibility that we see everywhere. Even now they are often taken seriously. The subject of this chapter is why there is no fundamental contradiction.</jats:p>
title: The Paradoxes of Irreversibility
